commit.subject: chore(deps): upgrade to TypeScript 6
commit.body: Bump typescript to ^6.0.3 and @types/node to ^25.9.3, and set compilerOptions.types to ["node"] in the base tsconfig. TypeScript 6.0 no longer auto-includes @types packages, so the explicit types entry is required for Node globals and node:* module resolution; the build and test tsconfigs inherit it via extends. No source changes. This aligns the project's authoritative type-check with the TypeScript version Deno bundles, unblocking the Deno runtime work.
